explanation: Foot, Hand (as in 'hands-breadth'), Cubit, and Span are all historical units of length derived from parts of the human body. Pound, however, is a unit of mass.

category: Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The Great Pyramid of Giza, Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Lighthouse of Alexandria, and Colossus of Rhodes are all traditionally recognized as four of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The Eiffel Tower is a modern architectural marvel, not part of the ancient list.

category: Literal Objects That Can Be Physically Broken
explanation: Glass, bone, plate, and branch are all physical objects that can be literally broken, fractured, or shattered. A promise is an abstract concept that can be 'broken' only in a figurative sense.
